_comment: A small sample spell list, read by src/js/spells.js. `level` is 0 for a
cantrip. `classes` names whichever classes in data/spell-slots.json can
cast it — matched by name the same case-insensitive way class-features.js
matches a character's classLevels. Descriptions are short and plain text
(unlike a class feature's, these are not Markdown).

spells.name: Fire Bolt
spells.description: A mote of fire streaks toward a creature or object within range. Make a ranged spell attack; on a hit, the target takes 1d10 fire damage.

spells.name: Mage Hand
spells.description: A spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range. It can manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, or pour out a vial.

spells.name: Sacred Flame
spells.description: Flame-like radiance descends on a creature you can see. It must succeed on a Dexterity save or take 1d8 radiant damage. The target gains no benefit from cover for this save.

spells.name: Guidance
spells.description: You touch one willing creature. Once before the spell ends, the target can roll 1d4 and add it to one ability check of its choice.

spells.name: Eldritch Blast
spells.description: A beam of crackling energy streaks toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack; on a hit, the target takes 1d10 force damage.

spells.name: Magic Missile
spells.description: You create three glowing darts of magical force. Each dart hits a creature of your choice within range, dealing 1d4 + 1 force damage.

spells.name: Shield
spells.description: An invisible barrier of magical force appears and protects you. Until the start of your next turn you have +5 AC and take no damage from magic missile.

spells.name: Cure Wounds
spells.description: A creature you touch regains a number of hit points equal to 1d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier.

spells.name: Bless
spells.description: You bless up to three creatures of your choice within range. Whenever a target makes an attack roll or a saving throw before the spell ends, it adds 1d4.

spells.name: Hex
spells.description: You place a curse on a creature within range. Whenever the target takes damage from one of your attacks or spells, it takes an extra 1d6 necrotic damage.

spells.name: Misty Step
spells.description: Briefly surrounded by silvery mist, you teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

spells.name: Scorching Ray
spells.description: You create three rays of fire and hurl them at targets within range. Make a ranged spell attack for each ray; a hit deals 2d6 fire damage.

spells.name: Spiritual Weapon
spells.description: You create a floating, spectral weapon that lasts for the duration. As a bonus action you can move it and make a melee spell attack against a creature within 5 feet of it, dealing 1d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier force damage on a hit.

spells.name: Fireball
spells.description: A bright streak flashes to a point you choose and blossoms into a fiery explosion. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere makes a Dexterity save, taking 8d6 fire damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

spells.name: Spirit Guardians
spells.description: Protective spirits flit around you in a 15-foot radius. A creature that enters or starts its turn there takes 3d8 radiant or necrotic damage (your choice) on a failed Wisdom save, or half as much on a success.

spells.name: Hypnotic Pattern
spells.description: A twisting pattern of colors weaves through the air. Each creature in a 30-foot cube that can see it must succeed on a Wisdom save or become charmed and incapacitated for the duration.
